subject: How to get the factor correlation matrix in case of imputed data

messages.author: 93e4893e69ec8930
messages.subject: How to get the factor correlation matrix in case of imputed data
parts:
Hi all,

I run some CFAs using imputed data through mice. 

I actually have no idea if there is any convenient way to extract the factor correlation matrix. It seems that 'lavinspect(fit, "cor.lv")' does not work in the case of imputed data sets.

Apologies if I miss anything or repeat a question that has already been asked (I at least did not find any post on this). 

Best,

Dom

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: How to get the factor correlation matrix in case of imputed data
parts: I actually have no idea if there is any convenient way to extract the factor correlation matrix. It seems that 'lavinspect(fit, "cor.lv")' does not work in the case of imputed data sets.

Correct, there is no analogous option for a class?lavaan.mi object.  You just have to look at the standardized solution in the summary() method.

Caveat:  If you use std.lv = TRUE, then the estimated factor covariances are already correlations, so you could save the lavInspect(fit, "cor.lv") ouput for each imputation and average the matrices using Reduce().  Extending the help-page example:

HSMiss <- HolzingerSwineford1939[ , c(paste("x", 1:9, sep = ""),
                                      "ageyr","agemo","school")]
set.seed(12345)
HSMiss$x5 <- ifelse(HSMiss$x5 <= quantile(HSMiss$x5, .3), NA, HSMiss$x5)
age <- HSMiss$ageyr + HSMiss$agemo/12
HSMiss$x9 <- ifelse(age <= quantile(age, .3), NA, HSMiss$x9)

## specify CFA model from lavaan's ?cfa help page
HS.model <- '
  visual  =~ x1 + x2 + x3
  textual =~ x4 + x5 + x6
  speed   =~ x7 + x8 + x9
'
## function to save list of extra output per imputation
getCors <- function(x) {
  list(LV = lavInspect(x, "cor.lv"), ALL = lavInspect(x, "cor.all"))
}
## impute data within runMI
nImps <- 20
out <- cfa.mi(HS.model, data = HSMiss, std.lv = TRUE,
              FUN = getCors, m = nImps, seed = 12345,
              miArgs = list(noms = "school"))
## pool latent correlation matrices
Reduce("+", lapply(out@funList, function(x) x$LV))  / nImps
## pool latent+observed correlation matrices
Reduce("+", lapply(out@funList, function(x) x$ALL))  / nImps
